// TST-900001
// level: unit
// module: MOD-result-records
// guards: EVERY TEST RUN LEAVES A RESULT RECORD
// given: a successful deterministic case
// input: the report's passing case
// expect: the ready value

// TST-900002
// level: component
// module: MOD-result-records
// guards: EVERY TEST RUN LEAVES A RESULT RECORD
// given: a deterministic assertion failure
// input: the report's failing case
// expect: expected <ready> & stable

// TST-900003
// level: unit
// module: MOD-result-records
// guards: EVERY TEST RUN LEAVES A RESULT RECORD
// given: a deterministic execution error
// input: the report's error case
// expect: the operation completes

// TST-900004
// level: component
// module: MOD-result-records
// guards: EVERY TEST RUN LEAVES A RESULT RECORD
// given: a skipped deterministic case
// input: the report's skipped case
// expect: the operation runs

// TST-900005
// level: unit
// module: MOD-result-records
// guards: EVERY TEST RUN LEAVES A RESULT RECORD
// given: a declared test absent from the report
// input: no case
// expect: the operation runs

// TST-900010
// level: unit
// module: MOD-result-records
// guards: EVERY TEST RUN LEAVES A RESULT RECORD
// given: two passing cases of one deterministic test
// input: both cases
// expect: both pass

// TST-900011
// level: unit
// module: MOD-result-records
// guards: EVERY TEST RUN LEAVES A RESULT RECORD
// given: a passing and failing case of one deterministic test
// input: both cases
// expect: both pass

// TST-900012
// level: component
// module: MOD-result-records
// guards: EVERY TEST RUN LEAVES A RESULT RECORD
// given: a passing and skipped case of one deterministic test
// input: both cases
// expect: both run and pass

// TST-900020
// level: system
// module: system
// guards: A MODEL-DEPENDENT TEST IS MEASURED AS A RATE
// given: four recorded responses, no paid call
// input: four responses fixed before the first run
// expect: a measured success rate
// runs: 4
// phrasings: 2

// TST-900021
// level: system
// module: system
// guards: A MODEL-DEPENDENT TEST IS MEASURED AS A RATE
// given: fewer than four executed responses
// input: two responses and one skipped response
// expect: incomplete, not run
// runs: 4
// phrasings: 2
